scope: RQ4a patched-sandbox sensitivity of singleton-ranked screening width under a fixed selected-statistics budget; this protocol does not retune the canonical Advisor configuration.

screening_semantics.eligible_universe: The same utility-independent eligible universe used by completed rq4-fixed-k-v2.
screening_semantics.singleton_profile: Reuse the committed RQ2-v2 singleton profile; do not reprofile.
screening_semantics.profile_reuse_accounting: new singleton profiling work is zero, while source profiling configuration/query/time accounting remains reported.
screening_semantics.finite_width: C_K is the first K_s eligible candidates in the frozen singleton order after eligibility filtering; no reranking is performed.
screening_semantics.all_width: C_all is the complete eligible universe.
screening_semantics.search: Frozen Advisor incidence-incremental Greedy ADD with strict improvement, selected count k <= B, deterministic ties, merged-map utility, proposal caching, empty-incidence and nonincident invariants, and incomplete-round discard semantics.
screening_semantics.budget_censoring: A budget-censored point preserves the last fully committed incumbent and is valid evidence; it is not relabeled as a completed k=4 optimum.

all_reuse.failure_policy: fail closed; never silently rerun all

interpretation.Ks_8_label: canonical screening-width reference under fixed B=4
interpretation.finite_width_lower_objective: A lower objective than Census13/DMV11 all may indicate that a narrower search breadth enabled more committed progress within the same bounded budget; it does not establish a better unrestricted optimum.
interpretation.pareto_analysis: Future descriptive objective-versus-cost nondominated-point analysis must not retroactively change canonical K_s=8.

execution_policy.formal_command_scope: one dataset per invocation; sandbox/RQ4a only; no stock DSN
